CustomField.description: Links this Prompt Template to the AI Agent it belongs to. The Agent's standing guardrails apply automatically to every Prompt Template assigned to it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select the Agent this template is assigned to. An Agent can have several templates (for example one per task). This template is only considered when that Agent is active in a conversation, and inherits the Agent's settings automatically
CustomField.label: AI Agent
